newsitem.title: UK: Stakis Q4 hotel yield, occupancy rates rise.
newsitem.headline: Stakis Q4 hotel yield, occupancy rates rise.

text.p: Hotels operator Stakis Plc said its fourth quarter yields per available room and occupancy rates rose in the fourth quarter to September 29, with turnover in the hotels division increasing to 39.4 million stg to 32.7 million.

"Occupancy, room rate and yield have all increased satisfactorily this quarter reflecting the trend for the whole year," said Stakis, which has been frequently reported as being close to buying Lonrho 's Metropole chain.
Turnover in Stakis casino division rose to 14.3 million from 13.1 million stg.
Stakis said management efforts to boost the casino results are beginning to come through, adding that future prospects were good.

Turnover in the health and leisure division, formed after the 19.75 million stg acquisition of Livingwell in May, was 3.0 million in the fourth quarter. No comparative figure was available. Stakis said results of the new division met group objectives.
